title: Vanishing of native smooth dualizing cohomology outside the exceptional degree
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sf-weil-smooth-dualizing-concentration, for every integer i different from -2d the cohomology Weil sheaf H^i of J applied to the constant Weil complex on Spec k₀ is zero.

source.place: Apply smooth purity to the structure morphism and the constant coefficient object; native exceptional adjunction and canonical Frobenius refinement.

proof.text: Instantiate the finite-field coefficient model and invoke the coefficient-stage smooth exceptional vanishing family.
For each degree i different from -2d, transport the coefficient endpoint zero object along the comparison isomorphism supplied for J and i.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient-stage smooth purity, normalized native comparison, and isZero transport.

created.why: Strictly smaller homological vanishing component used to derive the target t-structure bounds.

lean.statement: theorem smooth_dualizing_homology_vanishing (J : WeilComplex k₀ l (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) ⥤ WeilComplex k₀ l X) (adj : derivedLowerShriek k₀ l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) ⊣ J) (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] : ∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ -2 * (d : ℤ) → IsZero ((homologySheaf i).obj (J.obj (WeilSheaf.toComplex.obj (WeilSheaf.adicConstant k₀ l (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))))))
